en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a small-town street with stone and wooden buildings. On the right is a tall, narrow, multi-storey tower-like building with a stone ground floor and wooden upper floors, topped by a small octagonal pavilion and balcony. To the left, a row of houses lines a gently curving street with a few pedestrians. In the distance, there is a church with a steeple partially obscured by trees and a stone wall. Handwritten text in a cursive script covers much of the sky area and margins of the card.
